title: An exceptional experience.
text: My partner and I went a week ago. We wanted to enjoy a different yet fun experience, and that is exactly what we achieved with this workshop. Pedro, a really nice guy, gave us the workshop and taught us a lot! We left delighted and eager to do it again.
author: TrailBlazer656950

title: I had a really good time and learned.
text:
The atmosphere was family-friendly and conciliatory. I, who am by no means knowledgeable in rhythmic arts, achieved a great result while enjoying a pleasant time. 
I have achieved something I have been pursuing for years: being able to play the cajón without sounding like a deaf person hitting a bass drum. And that guy Pedro, what a great instructor! My congratulations on such an entertaining and beneficial project. When I am at the best ‘tablaos’, I will remember him and all my colleagues 😉😉.
author: L3953DMmarcosc

title: Unforgettable cajón classes
text:
Pedro is a great professional who teaches with a lot of patience, making the classes dynamic yet productive.
I undoubtedly recommend the classes 100%
author: 508danyi
